intro: Osaka rewards visitors with its legendary street food, lively nightlife, and rich history. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Osaka Metro and JR trains cover the city; use an IC card like ICOCA.
Buses are useful but less frequent; taxis are easy to hail.
Ride apps: Uber and GO work in Osaka.
Driving is not recommended for visitors; parking is expensive.
Walking and cycling are great in central areas; rent bikes from stations.
Ferries connect to Kansai Airport and nearby islands.

osaka_castle.name: Osaka Castle
osaka_castle.hours: Main tower 09:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30) · park always open
osaka_castle.tip: Climb the main tower early; the park and moat walk are free and best in spring for cherry blossom.

dotonbori.name: Dotonbori
dotonbori.hours: Always open · neon best after dark
dotonbori.tip: Come after sunset for the neon and the Glico sign; eat takoyaki and kushikatsu from street stalls.

umeda_sky.name: Umeda Sky Building
umeda_sky.price_text: ≈ ¥1,500 floating garden · check on the day
umeda_sky.hours: Floating Garden roughly 09:30–22:30 · check on the day
umeda_sky.tip: Go up near sunset to see the city turn to lights; the open-air deck is windy, bring a layer.

tsutenkaku.name: Tsutenkaku
tsutenkaku.price_text: ≈ ¥900 tower deck · check on the day
tsutenkaku.tip: The Shinsekai streets below are the real draw; try kushikatsu and watch the retro signs.

shitennoji.name: Shitenno-ji
shitennoji.tip: One of Japan's oldest temples; the quiet pond garden is a good break from the crowds.

sumiyoshi.name: Sumiyoshi Taisha
sumiyoshi.tip: Look for the curved Sorihashi bridge; go early for calm and fewer visitors.

usj.name: Universal Studios Japan
usj.price_text: ≈ ¥8,600+ one-day ticket · prices vary by date
usj.hours: Roughly 09:00–21:00 · hours vary, check on the day
usj.tip: Buy a dated ticket online and arrive before opening; weekday visits are calmer.

asahi_suita.name: Asahi Breweries Suita
asahi_suita.price_text: ≈ ¥1,000 tour with tasting · check on the day
asahi_suita.tip: Book the factory tour ahead; it ends with a tasting and is easy by train from Umeda.

bunraku.name: Bunraku Theatre
bunraku.price_text: ≈ ¥2,000+ single-act seats · full programs cost more
bunraku.hours: Performances on set dates · check the schedule
bunraku.tip: Single-act tickets are a cheap way to try puppet theatre; English audio guides help.

dotonbori_cruise.name: Dotonbori River Cruise
dotonbori_cruise.tip: Take the evening run for the neon reflections; buy tickets at the dock.

horyuji.name: Horyu-ji
horyuji.price_text: ≈ ¥1,500 combined precinct ticket · check on the day
horyuji.tip: A day trip to Nara Prefecture; among the world's oldest wooden buildings, so allow travel time.

kobe_harborland.name: Kobe Harborland
kobe_harborland.price_text: Free to walk · shops and rides cost extra
kobe_harborland.tip: A short train ride from Osaka; come at dusk for the port lights and the ferris wheel.

kuromon.name: Kuromon Ichiba Market
kuromon.price_text: Free to enter · pay per stall
kuromon.tip: Go before lunch for the freshest stalls; eat where you buy and carry cash.

kaiyukan.name: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan
kaiyukan.tip: The whale-shark tank is the highlight; go on a weekday morning to avoid school groups.

osaka_university.name: Osaka University
osaka_university.hours: Campus generally open daytime · check on the day
osaka_university.tip: A quiet green campus for a stroll; not a headline sight, so pair it with nearby stops.

rokko_arima.name: Rokko-Arima Ropeway
rokko_arima.price_text: ≈ ¥1,600 one way · check on the day
rokko_arima.tip: A day trip into the hills above Kobe; check the weather and last ride time before going.

toshodaiji.name: Toshodai-ji
toshodaiji.tip: In Nara, near Yakushi-ji; combine both temples in one day trip.

yakushiji.name: Yakushi-ji
yakushiji.tip: Famous for its twin pagodas; a calm stop on a Nara day trip.

yodo_river.name: Yodo River
yodo_river.tip: Walk or cycle the riverside promenade at sunset; a local, low-key break from the crowds.

shinsekai_walk.name: Shinsekai neighbourhood walk
shinsekai_walk.tip: Retro streets under Tsutenkaku; try kushikatsu and the old-school game arcades.

amerikamura.name: Amerikamura walk
amerikamura.tip: Osaka's youth fashion and street-food district; good for browsing and people-watching.

shinsaibashi_suji.name: Shinsaibashi-suji shopping street
shinsaibashi_suji.price_text: Free to walk · pay per shop
shinsaibashi_suji.tip: A long covered arcade linking to Dotonbori; handy on a rainy day.

takoyaki_class.name: Takoyaki cooking class
takoyaki_class.price_text: ≈ ¥3,000–4,000 per person · check on the day
takoyaki_class.tip: Learn to make Osaka's octopus balls; book ahead and check the language of instruction.

nakanoshima_park.name: Nakanoshima Park
nakanoshima_park.tip: Riverside park between the city halls; a calm walk with rose gardens in season.

tennoji_park.name: Tennoji Park
tennoji_park.tip: Green space next to Tennoji zoo and Shitenno-ji; good for a rest between sights.

stays.why: Steps from Dotonbori nightlife and easy train links to the airport and Kyoto.
Main rail hub for day trips; big malls and food halls under the station.
Shopping arcade on your doorstep, walkable to Namba and Dotonbori.
Quieter and often cheaper; good rail links and park nearby.

food: Try takoyaki and okonomiyaki; Dotonbori has plenty of stalls and small shops.
Kuromon Ichiba market is good for grilled seafood and skewers; prices vary, check before you buy.
Kushikatsu (fried skewers) is a local specialty; the Shinsekai area is known for it.
Convenience stores and standing noodle bars are cheap and quick, often under ¥1000 a meal.
Book popular restaurants ahead or go early; many small places are cash-friendly.
more_time: Swap a city day for a day trip to Kyoto or Nara by train; check times and fares on the day.
Add a half-day at Universal Studios Japan if you like theme parks; buy tickets ahead.
Spend an evening in Shinsekai for kushikatsu and the retro atmosphere.
